##### Project general facts

Marquis Signature is a one-of-a-kind luxury development that reinvents the conventional idea of modern living, offering something truly personal that feels unique like your own signature. The collection spans one, two and three-bedroom apartments, all superiorly equipped, fully furnished mobile-operable smart homes with high ceilings, connected balconies between rooms and walk-in wardrobes. Two-bedroom homes add a privacy corridor and a store or maid's room, while the three-bedroom residences are the ultimate indulgence with a suite-sized master bedroom, dedicated dressing area, landscaped private terrace and an exclusive private pool.

A remarkable share of the building is devoted to amenities, beginning with an opulent double-height designer lobby crowned by an exquisite chandelier, a dedicated concierge desk, drop-off area, three customised elevators with a separate service elevator, and smart parking with electric car charging. Recreation is generous and resort-style, with a temperature-controlled semi-Olympic three-sided infinity pool, spa, steam and sauna, a fully equipped gym, meditation and yoga deck, private cinema with plush seating, indoor and outdoor games, and a contemporary hall connected to a barbeque area for celebrations. Nine gardens invite leisurely strolls, complemented by a roof garden with a rooftop barbeque area, a smart business centre with conference rooms and working pods, a contemporary cafe, and a kids' area with a silent garden alongside.

The signature floors are finished to an especially high standard, with a dedicated lounge, customised lobby with an opulent garden, designer corridors and smart kitchens that make daily life effortless. Interiors are warm and refined throughout, featuring designer porcelain flooring, curtain pelmets, customised branded light fittings, fire-rated main doors, double-glazed windows with thermal break sections and elegant stone surfaces in the kitchens and bathrooms. Only the best international brands qualify here, with certified premium sanitaryware, faucets, switches, cabinetry hardware, appliances, elevators and air conditioning ensuring that every fitting and fixture feels top-notch and built to last.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Arjan, a residential community located near popular Dubai attractions such as Dubai Miracle Garden and Mall of the Emirates, this exceptional location offers a family-friendly environment with a safe and secure atmosphere. The area provides various amenities including landscaped gardens, swimming pools, fitness centers, and retail outlets, making it a convenient place to live.

The location is distinguished by its excellent connectivity to the rest of Dubai through Dubai-Al Ain Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, and Al Khail Road. Several schools, healthcare facilities, and supermarkets are in the area, while parks and playgrounds provide residents with opportunities for outdoor activities and recreation.

For those seeking a residence that embodies urban luxury, smart innovation, and a prime Dubai address, Arjan delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of natural beauty, world-class amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living — refined, connected and effortlessly inspiring.
